property_summary: For any target and value, calling sendMoney forwards the call and reverts the transaction if the external call fails; the mutant removes the require so failing callee calls no longer revert, which the test detects when a callee intentionally reverts.
change_summary: Remove the require check so sendMoney no longer reverts on call failure, allowing calls that fail to complete and changing observable behavior (balance/state of target may differ).
